title: The first IWGP Women’s Championship chapter
summary: KAIRI, Mercedes Moné and Mayu Iwatani establish the early identity of the IWGP Women’s title. Its opening story crosses New Japan, Stardom and their joint events.

chapters.title: KAIRI becomes the first champion
chapters.result: KAIRI defeats Iwatani in the tournament final.
chapters.context: The joint event establishes the championship with a meeting between two major Stardom-associated stars.

chapters.title: Mercedes wins in her New Japan debut
chapters.result: Moné defeats KAIRI for the IWGP Women’s title.
chapters.context: The high-profile newcomer converts her arrival into a championship reign in San Jose.

chapters.title: Iwatani earns the title she first missed
chapters.result: Iwatani defeats Moné for the IWGP Women’s championship.
chapters.context: At a Stardom event, Iwatani completes the pursuit that began with her loss in the inaugural tournament final.
